name: TISAX exchange platform
description: The exchange platform is provided by the ENX portal (enx.com/en-US/SignIn); the audit provider uploads sections A and B of the TISAX assessment report to it; the participant can then publish the assessment result to all TISAX participants (only if the overall assessment result is conform, at sharing level A, A + Labels, or A + Labels + B) or share it with particular participants using their Participant ID (sharing levels A through A + Labels + B + C + D + E); publication and sharing permissions cannot be revoked and remain valid for the complete validity period of the assessment; results are visible to TISAX participants only, there is no public listing
